run_maskcut_pipeline: run the MaskCut pipeline on ImageNet images to generate COCO-style pseudo-mask annotations using a DINO ViT backbone
run_maskcut_forward: run the maskcut_forward function to compute N pseudo-masks from ViT patch features using spectral graph cuts
run_maskcut_single_image: run the maskcut function on a single image path to extract bipartitions and eigenvectors using a DINO backbone
create_coco_annotation_info: create a COCO-style annotation info dictionary from a binary mask with RLE encoding and bounding box
create_coco_image_info: create a COCO-style image info dictionary with image ID, file name, and dimensions
